400 Bad Request error when search query is empty

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import SearchRequest
from liter_llm import BadRequestError, LiterLlmError

async def main() -> None:
    try:
        client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
        req = SearchRequest.from_json("{\"model\":\"brave/web-search\",\"query\":\"\"}")
        await client.search(req)
    except BadRequestError as error:
        print(f"BadRequestError: {error}")
    except LiterLlmError as error:
        print(f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")

asyncio.run(main())
```
